text: Oi oi, Chief!\nGot something legendary to show me?[VAR 0114(0076)]
Have a look!
Let’s battle!
Never mind
Aha, changed your mind?\nFair enough![VAR 0114(0076)]
What’ve you got for me?[VAR 0114(0076)]
Hold the phone, Chief. You haven’t got any\nLegendary Pokémon with you!\r\nGahaha! It happens![VAR 0114(0076)]
Never mind
Oh? Don’t feel like showing me anything\nlegendary after all?\r\nGahaha! It happens![VAR 0114(0076)]

Aha! That’s Mewtwo, the ferocious Pokémon
created through genetic manipulation, isn’t it?\c
Its face is a bit on the pale side...
Seems docile for the most part, though!\c
It might not have the friendliest-lookin’ mug,
but I’ll bet you it’s a decent sort on the inside![VAR 0114(0076)]

Oho, here it is!
Our imposter Articuno!\c
I always wonder what it’s thinkin’ in there behind
that dodgy mask...\c
D’you get the feelin’ it’s lookin’ down its beak at
us? Maybe it’s my imagination.[VAR 0114(0076)]

Whoa! It’s our imposter Articuno, only without
that dodgy mask!\c
Bet you it gets a lot more fans with those
sharp, bright eyes out in the open, eh?\c
Hang on, though—has it gotten chilly in here?
Did a blizzard blow in or somethin’?[VAR 0114(0076)]

Oho, here it is!
Our imposter Zapdos!\c
Seems like it’s done its best to be jagged and
spiky and make its beak nice and sharp.\c
It really wants to be a proper Zapdos!
Full marks for effort![VAR 0114(0076)]

Whoa! Looks like you’d get a massive jolt if you
laid a finger on this one!\c
Our imposter Zapdos must’ve gotten some static
electricity in the old feathers!\c
Static builds up somethin’ fierce when the air
gets cold and dry, doesn’t it?[VAR 0114(0076)]

Oho, here it is!
Our imposter Moltres!\c
It may look a bit like it’s ablaze,
but it’s barely lukewarm!\c
That ultra-mega-feisty look in its eyes actually
makes me feel like we’d get on all right.[VAR 0114(0076)]

Whoa!
Now those are some serious flames!\c
Hey, imposter Moltres!
Have you got a fever or somethin’?\c
You get some rest, hear me?
Take care of yourself![VAR 0114(0076)]

So this is the Legendary Pokémon Ho-Oh, eh?
The one with rainbow-colored wings?\c
There’s red for sure. Some white, some yellow...
A few hues short of a rainbow, though, isn’t it?\c
Oh well. I’d hate to crush all your dreams,
so I’ll take your word on it, Chief![VAR 0114(0076)]

So this is the Legendary Pokémon Lugia, eh?
The one they call the guardian of the seas?\c
And yet it’s a Flying type!
Fancy that—being able to swim and fly!
What CAN’T it do?\c
I’ve heard they’ve got these sportin’ events
called Pokéathlons in this one far-off region...
Bet you Lugia would be brilliant in those![VAR 0114(0076)]

So this is Raikou, the Pokémon they say
descended with a bolt of lightnin’?\c
That must’ve been a pretty rough ride,
eh, mate?\c
No wonder the mane on your back’s gone
all curly.[VAR 0114(0076)]

So this is Entei, the Pokémon they say was born
from a volcanic eruption?\c
Born from a volcano? Yeah, sure!
Pull the other one; it’s got bells on!\c
So you’re sayin’ its old man’s a volcano?
Or what—is its mum a volcano?[VAR 0114(0076)]

Wow! That’s a beautiful Pokémon, that is!
Is that Suicune?\c
It’s dead cool how that horn thing on its head
sort of makes a loop!\c
I wonder, though... How’s it supposed to roll over
when it wants to sleep on the other side?\c
I bet it’s got a rough time sleepin’ in general.
You all right, Suicune? Gettin’ your eight hours?[VAR 0114(0076)]

Whoa! Is that Groudon? The Pokémon they call
the personification of land?!\c
If the stories about how it sleeps in magma are
true...that’s brilliant!\c
I’m a regular at the sauna, so I get where it’s
coming from!\c
Bet it gets a nice spring in its step after a kip
in that magma![VAR 0114(0076)]

Whoa! Is that Kyogre? The Pokémon they say
created the seas?!\c
If the ocean’s the mother of all life...and Kyogre’s
the mother of the ocean...
Should we all be callin’ Kyogre our nan?!\c
Listen up, Chief... You better be nice and gentle
with that Kyogre![VAR 0114(0076)]

Huh? Rayquaza? Isn’t it supposed to live way up
high in the ozone layer?\c
Sounds like some serious high-altitude trainin’!
It must be one dedicated athlete!\c
Well, it’s sure got a tough enough look on
its face!\c
I dunno what your sport is, Rayquaza,
but keep it up![VAR 0114(0076)]

So this is Latias, a Pokémon that can read
people’s minds usin’ telepathy...\c
It’s got a right cute little face for such a powerful
Pokémon, hasn’t it?\c
All right, mate, let’s see what you can do!
What am I thinkin’ right now?\c
Wait, nope—cancel that!
That’s a terrifyin’ idea, now that I think about it![VAR 0114(0076)]

So Latios is supposed to be so dead smart, it
can understand human speech?\c
That’s brilliant if it’s true, but I dunno if I believe
it... It’s a lot to swallow!\c
Hey, Latios, mate. You’re sorta like a big brother
to Latias, right?\c
Well, listen. You be a proper big brother and
be good to Latias. Got it?[VAR 0114(0076)]

Aha, here’s our little rock giant! Gahaha!
Sorry to tease, mate. Just having a laugh.\c
Don’t you worry, rock giant—my respect for
you’s as thick as those broad shoulders!\c
Keep up the good work, my fine rugged friend![VAR 0114(0076)]

Aha, here’s our little ice giant! Gahaha!
Sorry to tease, mate. Just having a laugh.\c
Don’t you worry, ice giant—I can see the might
of your massiveness as clear as my reflection
on you!\c
Keep up the good work, my fine frozen friend![VAR 0114(0076)]

Aha, here’s our little steel giant! Gahaha!
Sorry to tease, mate. Just having a laugh.\c
Don’t you worry, steel giant—your bowling-ball
bod gets full marks from me! A perfect strike!\c
Keep up the good work, my fine smooth friend![VAR 0114(0076)]

So this is Dialga?
The Pokémon that controls time?\c
Well, if that’s not just talk...think it could give
me a cheeky rewind whenever I make my
darlin’ Nia mad?\c
That aside...has this thing got a bangin’ cry
or what?![VAR 0114(0076)]

So this is Palkia?
The Pokémon that controls space?\c
Well, if that’s not just talk...I’d sure love it if I
could catch up to my dear Peonia instantly
when she runs off! Just sayin’!\c
That aside...has this thing got a bangin’ cry
or what?![VAR 0114(0076)]

So this is Giratina? A Pokémon that lives in a
world on the reverse side of ours?\c
It must’ve taken ages to get here from clear
around the planet!
Go on—plop down and have a rest, mate!\c
Then again, looks like it’d be a speedy flier.
Maybe a trip like that’s a doddle for Giratina![VAR 0114(0076)]

Uxie, eh? The Pokémon that governs
knowledge and intelligence?\c
Brilliant! I might have a few tiny gaps in the
brains department...
Maybe it could front me some smarts!\c
Please and thank you kindly, O wise and
generous Uxie!\c
Hey, what do you know?
I feel brainier already! Gahaha![VAR 0114(0076)]

Mesprit, eh?
The Pokémon that brought people emotions?\c
I’ll admit I can get a tad caught up in my own
passions now and then...\c
Maybe Mesprit brought me a little too much?!
Nah, just having a bit of fun!\c
I may get happier or sadder than other folks...
but that just means I’m makin’ the most of life![VAR 0114(0076)]

Azelf, eh? The Pokémon that gives people the
willpower to get through sticky situations?\c
Maybe if I had one of these around, I’d be
better at draggin’ myself out of bed or cleanin’
up around the house!\c
Sounds like every home needs an Azelf!
I’ve got to catch myself one![VAR 0114(0076)]

Heatran, the Lava Dome Pokémon?
Hmm...\c
That stout, plump frame... That cheeky look on
its face...
What an ultra-mega-lovable Pokémon!\c
Where’d you find this treasure?
Forget legends—I’d like to have one just to
carry around![VAR 0114(0076)]

Whoa! Is that the boss of the legendary giants?!\c
It’s gigantic enough—that’s for sure!
One gianty giant!\c
With all these dots, though, I’ve got no idea
which ones are actually eyes.\c
Where’s a bloke supposed to look when he’s
talkin’ to this one?[VAR 0114(0076)]

Aha, it’s Cresselia! The Pokémon that represents
the crescent moon! Pretty, isn’t it?\c
Those archy bits on its back look pretty
stiff though, don’t they?\c
How’s the poor thing supposed to sleep on its
side? Can it even turn over in bed?
I worry about you, Cresselia...[VAR 0114(0076)]

Whoa! Is that Pokémon’s tail on fire?!\c
Wait—come again? They say this Pokémon could
scorch the world?\c
Well, don’t you look calm for someone carryin’
around a potent Pokémon like that, Chief?
That takes backbone, that does!\c
Just watch out you don’t get burned![VAR 0114(0076)]

Whoa! That Pokémon’s cracklin’ with electricity!\c
Wait—come again? They say this Pokémon could
blast the world with lightnin’?\c
Well, don’t you look calm for someone carryin’
around a mighty Pokémon like that, Chief?
That takes backbone, that does!\c
Just watch out you don’t get zapped![VAR 0114(0076)]

Fwhoo! Brrr!
I was wonderin’ why it got freezin’ cold all of a
sudden. Guess it’s your work, Kyurem!\c
Aren’t you the silly one, gettin’ frozen by your
own cold air!\c
That’s a bit of an odd bod though, innit?
Looks a little like there’s places to stick bits on
and take ’em off...\c
Whoops, that was rude of me!
Sorry about that, Kyurem![VAR 0114(0076)]

Wait, wait, wait! You’re tellin’ me that’s a
Legendary Pokémon?!\c
That mug’s a dead ringer for my grumpy
old neighbor!\c
So that’s Tornadus, the Cyclone Pokémon, eh?
Well, I guess my neighbor doesn’t stir up winds
that can blow houses away...[VAR 0114(0076)]

Wait, wait, wait! You’re tellin’ me that’s a
Legendary Pokémon?!\c
That mug’s a dead ringer for my grumpy
old neighbor!\c
So that’s Thundurus, the Bolt Strike Pokémon?
Well, I guess my neighbor doesn’t zoom through
the sky, droppin’ lightning everywhere...[VAR 0114(0076)]

Wait, wait, wait! You’re tellin’ me that’s a
Legendary Pokémon?!\c
That mug’s a dead ringer for my grumpy
old neighbor!\c
So that’s Landorus, the Abundance Pokémon?
Think it’s tryin’ to steal the King of Bountiful
Harvests’ thunder a bit?\c
They say this fella gives evildoers a thrashin’,
right? That bit’s just like my neighbor, too![VAR 0114(0076)]

That’s the Life Pokémon, Xerneas?
The one that can share eternal life?!\c
That’s brilliant and all, but what’s REALLY
brilliant is that set of antlers!\c
Those things are ultra-mega-splendid...but they
seem like they’d keep Xerneas from turnin’ over
in bed.\c
Is livin’ forever even worth it if you can’t get a
good kip in at night?[VAR 0114(0076)]

That’s the Destruction Pokémon, Yveltal?
The one that absorbs the life-force of
livin’ things?!\c
Looks a bit like the letter Y, doesn’t it?
Well, I’d sure like to know “why” Yveltal goes
around absorbin’ life-force like that!\c
You can’t go stealin’ a bloke’s life-force without
so much as a how-d’you-do![VAR 0114(0076)]

So this is Zygarde, a Pokémon made up of
lots of little cells gathered together...\c
Just goes to show how little bits here and there
add up! Makes you more than the sum of your
pants, or however that sayin’ goes!\c
Take me, for instance—I get my daily workouts
in, and those add up to keep years off this old
bloke’s bod!\c
Zygarde’s right clever to have that principle
worked out![VAR 0114(0076)]

It’s Solgaleo, the Sunne Pokémon!
It practically roars “sun,” doesn’t it?\c
Can it really make the darkest of nights light up
like midday? That’s pretty cheeky!\c
Sounds like it’d be a great help on those nights
you just don’t want to head home yet, though!\c
Eh? It comes from another world, too?!
That’s one fired-up Pokémon![VAR 0114(0076)]

It’s Lunala, the Moone Pokémon!
It practically howls “moon,” doesn’t it?\c
Can it really make it dark as night even in the
full bright of day? That’s pretty cheeky!\c
Sounds like it’d be a great help on those
mornings you need a bit more kip, though!\c
Eh? It comes from another world, too?!
That’s one fired-up Pokémon![VAR 0114(0076)]

So this one’s Necrozma, the Prism Pokémon?
Looks pretty dark and...un-prism-y, eh?\c
What?! It came from another world, lookin’
for light?\c
Sounds like you just need to get more time
out in the sun, Necrozma, mate!\c
Chin up—you’ll be sparklin’ with energy in no
time! The picture of prismatic health![VAR 0114(0076)]

Nihilego, eh? The Parasite Pokémon?
Whoa! Looks soft and floaty as a dream!\c
Just think how cozy you’d be, havin’ one to rest
your head on like a pillow!\c
Y’know, Chief, you did take that lovely pillow I
found before...\c
Come on—let me have Nihilego wrap nice and
gentle around my noggin for a bit! It’s only fair![VAR 0114(0076)]

Gahaha! Just look at the muscles on Buzzwole!
That’s one Swollen Pokémon, all right!\c
I don’t mind sayin’ I’m stronger than most,
but I’ve got to bow down to your brawn, mate!\c
You and me, Buzzwole—we ought to go get a
few reps in sometime! I’ll spot you![VAR 0114(0076)]

Pheromosa, eh? The Lissome Pokémon?
Seems ultra-mega-refined! That’s a Pokémon
with class!\c
Pleasure to make your acquaintance, Pheromosa!
What do you say to a handshake?\c
... ... ...
... ... ...\c
That...might’ve been the coldest shoulder I’ve
ever got. Did I do somethin’ wrong, Chief?[VAR 0114(0076)]

It’s Xurkitree, the Glowing Pokémon!
What’s it playin’ at, being so pointy?!\c
Looks a bit like it’s got plugs on its limbs...
Does it light up if you plug it into a socket?
I bet it’d look smashin’!\c
Actually...cancel that. Just the thought of the
electric bill I’d get gives me the shivers.[VAR 0114(0076)]

What? Kartana, the Drawn Sword Pokémon?\c
Sure, Chief—pull the other one!
I know a piece of origami when I see one.\c
Whoever made this has got an eye for detail,
though. There’s serious care in this foldin’!\c
Keep an eye on that—it’d be a right shame if it
got blown away in the wind or put through
the wash![VAR 0114(0076)]

Gwaaah! That thing’s MASSIVE!\c
Whoops...sorry to shout.
Got a bit carried away from the shock!\c
That’s Celesteela, the Launch Pokémon, eh?
And it flies around superfast by firin’
flammable gas from those arms?\c
I can’t think of more to say about that than...
absolutely wicked!\c
Gotta say though, Chief...the odd ones sure
seem to take a shine to you, don’t they?[VAR 0114(0076)]

Guzzlord, the Junkivore Pokémon?\c
Couldn’t have named it better. Look at it go,
chowin’ down on that rubbish!\c
Good for you, you great gourmand!
No one could call you a fussy eater!\c
Chief, if you’ve ever got some rubbish you can’t
be bothered to bin, toss that one a treat![VAR 0114(0076)]

So this Poipole’s a Poison Pin Pokémon that came
from another world?\c
Guess it’s got a bit of an unusual face, but it
doesn’t look that different from the type of
thing I could find in tall grass around here...\c
Gwaaah! Did those needles on its noggin just
spray out poison?!
Whatever world it came from must be wild![VAR 0114(0076)]

So this Naganadel’s a Poison Pin Pokémon that
came from another world?\c
That massive pointy needle sure looks
ultra-mega-strong, all right!\c
But, er...how’s it meant to kip with those three
needles pokin’ out of its backside?\c
You all right, Naganadel, mate?
You gettin’ enough sleep there?[VAR 0114(0076)]

The Rampart Pokémon, Stakataka!
That’s one mysterious life-form, all right!\c
Look how many little blocks make up this one
Pokémon. They’re just the right size for a pillow
too, eh? Wonder if it’d let me have one...\c
Oops! Guess not!
Fair enough—losin’ part of your body’s no fun!\c
Come to think of it... How many blocks would it
have to lose to not be a Stakataka anymore?[VAR 0114(0076)]

The Fireworks Pokémon, Blacephalon!
That’s one mysterious life-form, all right!\c
It’s a funny one to look at with all that
wigglin’, isn’t it?\c
Bit less funny to get so desperate you blow up
your own noggin, though!\c
Gettin’ the drop on someone’s great and all,
but don’t lose your head over it, eh?[VAR 0114(0076)]

Who’s this rockin’ the mohawk, Chief?
Friend of yours?\c
What? It’s Tapu Koko, a Land Spirit Pokémon
that’s the guardian deity of some island?!\c
Hm! Sneakin’ in a bit of undercover travel, is it?
Well, not far under cover with that
ultra-mega-flash hairdo stickin’ out!\c
Maybe I ought to try out a mohawk if I ever
get tired of the ol’ buzz cut![VAR 0114(0076)]

Who’s this rockin’ the perm, Chief?
Friend of yours?\c
What? It’s Tapu Lele, a Land Spirit Pokémon
that’s the guardian deity of some island?!\c
Hm! Sneakin’ in a bit of undercover travel, is it?
Bit small for that, though. Bet its papa’s worried!\c
Guess its family believes in lettin’ its little ones
find their own way...[VAR 0114(0076)]

Who’s this rockin’ the horns, Chief?
Friend of yours?\c
Oh, it’s Tapu Bulu, a Land Spirit Pokémon
that’s the guardian deity of some island?!\c
Hm! Sneakin’ in a bit of undercover travel, is it?
Sure looks pleased enough with itself...\c
It...has noticed its horns have poked right
through its hat, hasn’t it?\c
Part of me thinks I ought to let it know...
but maybe that’s my lack of tact talkin’.[VAR 0114(0076)]

Who’s this rockin’ the eyelashes, Chief?
Friend of yours?\c
Oh, it’s Tapu Fini, a Land Spirit Pokémon
that’s the guardian deity of some island?!\c
Hm! Sneakin’ in a bit of undercover travel, is it?\c
Hang on... Is it me, or is there loads more
moisture in the air all of a sudden?
My throat’s feelin’ great now!\c
Cheers, Tapu Fini! They ought to make you the
guardian deity of humidifyin’ too![VAR 0114(0076)]

Aha, here’s our little electric giant! Gahaha!
Sorry to tease, mate. Just having a laugh.\c
Don’t you worry, electric giant—when I say you
look like a great, bright piece of candy, I mean
it in the best way!\c
Keep up the good work, my fine crackly friend![VAR 0114(0076)]

Aha, here’s our little dragon giant! Gahaha!
Sorry to tease, mate. Just having a laugh.\c
Don’t you worry, dragon giant—I’ve got great
respect for clothespins, and you look like the
greatest of all!\c
Keep up the good work, my fine pinchy friend![VAR 0114(0076)]

So this is Glastrier? The King of Bountiful
Harvests’ Wild Horse Pokémon?\c
Seems like it’s quit bein’ its old bullyin’ self and
is actually bein’ loyal to the king!\c
If I went for a ride on that thing, it might make
my legs nice and cool, but I bet I’d get a
bit queasy!\c
The King of Bountiful Harvests must have some
leg-endary leg strength to stay astride this one![VAR 0114(0076)]

So this is Spectrier? The King of Bountiful
Harvests’ Swift Horse Pokémon?\c
Seems like it’s quit bein’ its old bullyin’ self and
is actually bein’ loyal to the king!\c
I get the feelin’ if I went for a ride on that thing,
it’d whisk me off to who-knows-where!
Bit scary, I don’t mind sayin’!\c
The king’s got to have some legendary guts
to ride around on this one all the time![VAR 0114(0076)]

Oi oi! As grand a noggin as ever, eh?\c
That’s our King of Bountiful Harvests, isn’t it?
The one callin’ the shots around here!
It’s a dead ringer for the statue in Freezington!\c
Hm... Y’know, when I get a good look at it...that
head of yours sure looks like my lovely pillow![VAR 0114(0076)]

Oho! Calyrex, the King of Bountiful Harvests!\c
It sure does look just like the legends say,
ridin’ majestically up on that loyal steed!\c
I’ve got an odd feelin’...like I met it somewhere
before you caught it, Chief...\c
But no matter how hard I think about it, I’m just
drawin’ a blank!\c
Huh... Did you hear a little voice say “thank you”
just now? Or am I hearin’ things?[VAR 0114(0076)]
All right! Let’s go a round, then!\nGet ultra-mega-ready, Chief![VAR 0114(0076)]

Gahaha! That’s why you’re the chief, Chief!
Mighty strong Pokémon you’ve got!\c
Copperajah and the rest look ultra-mega-
pleased that they got a chance to cut
loose, too![VAR 0114(0076)]

Ha! Chalk another one up for me!\c
Nothin’ feels as ultra-mega-great as leadin’ your
own Pokémon in battle, does it?\c
That’s why those Dynamax Adventures are so
tough by comparison![VAR 0114(0076)]

Come on now, Chief! We’ve already had us a
battle today!\c
I’ve got to let my Pokémon rest up a bit!
Try me again tomorrow![VAR 0114(0076)]
You actually caught a Pokémon by usin’ that\nmysterious clue?![VAR 0114(0076)]
Let me have a look, would you?[VAR 0114(0076)]
That’s that, anyway...\nChief, mind lettin’ me see that Legendary Clue?[VAR 0114(0076)]
Gaaahahaha!\nI didn’t write this clue, Chief...but let’s not let\r\nthat stop the fun![VAR 0114(0076)]
Erm...excuse me!\nWhere did you find that paper, exactly?!
Chief Peony dropped it...
It was at our base camp...
That’s actually from my notes. I wonder how this\ncould have happened...
Gahahaaa!\nHaven’t got a single shred of an idea![VAR 0114(0076)]
Indeed, sir. I imagine you haven’t.
Anyway, I’m quite relieved that you found\nthat paper.
Not to mention that you’ve caught Necrozma—\nthe one responsible for that Ultra Wormhole.
Please accept this with my thanks as a reward for\nyour cooperation in my research.
Oh, and no need to worry about returning the\npaper. I’ve got another copy.
I’ve got to hand it to you, Chief!\nOnly you could track down and catch a thing\r\nlike that with just a single photo to go on![VAR 0114(0076)]
Still, I’ve got to say...\nFeels like we’ve come to the end of a chapter\r\nor somethin’, doesn’t it?[VAR 0114(0076)]
You look ready to keep on goin’ for a while\nyet, though![VAR 0114(0076)]
Go on then, Chief!\nCan’t wait to hear about all the exploits and\r\nadventures you get up to from here on out![VAR 0114(0076)]
I don’t think that’s the Pokémon from the\nmysterious clue, Chief!\r\nKeep a sharp eye—the game’s still afoot![VAR 0114(0076)]

Hmm. This Pokémon certainly looks like the one
from that mysterious clue. I’ll give you that...\c
But somethin’ tells me this Pokémon didn’t come
from this lair!\c
I know it’s got to be a pain, Chief, but keep
searchin’! Slow and steady and all that![VAR 0114(0076)]
